entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] (β : ℝ) (x : ι → E) (v : E) (i : ι), softmax β x v i = Real.exp (β * inner ℝ (x i) v) / ∑ j, Real.exp (β * inner ℝ (x j) v)

entries.name: softmax_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype ι] (β : ℝ) (x : ι → E) (v : E) (i : ι), 0 ≤ softmax β x v i

entries.name: sub_eq_integral_quarterCircle
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 f → ∀ (u v : E), f u - f v = ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..Real.pi / 2, inner ℝ (gradient f (Real.sin θ • u + Real.cos θ • v)) (Real.cos θ • u - Real.sin θ • v)

entries.name: sum_exp_inner_pos

entries.name: sum_inner_sq_orthogonal_le_norm_sub_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {V : Submodule ℝ E} {κ : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (f : OrthonormalBasis κ ℝ ↥Vᗮ) (x : E) {v : E}, v ∈ V → ∑ j, inner ℝ x ↑(f j) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - v‖ ^ 2

entries.name: sum_inv_sub_half_sub_inv_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (a : ι → ℝ), (∀ (i : ι), 1 ≤ a i) → 0 < ∑ i, ((a i - 1 / 2)⁻¹ - (a i)⁻¹)

entries.name: sum_softmax

entries.name: supportFn_add
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K K' : Set E} {R R' : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → K'.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K', ‖x‖ ≤ R') → ∀ (ξ : E), supportFn (K + K') ξ = supportFn K ξ + supportFn K' ξ

entries.name: supportFn_add_le

entries.name: supportFn_eq_sSup
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (K : Set E) (ξ : E), supportFn K ξ = sSup ((fun x => inner ℝ x ξ) '' K)

entries.name: supportFn_image
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {F : Type u_2} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (K : Set E) {L : E → F} {L' : F → E}, (∀ (x : E) (ξ : F), inner ℝ (L x) ξ = inner ℝ x (L' ξ)) → ∀ (ξ : F), supportFn (L '' K) ξ = supportFn K (L' ξ)

entries.name: supportFn_le

entries.name: supportFn_le_mul_norm

entries.name: supportFn_mono

entries.name: supportFn_neg_set

entries.name: supportFn_smul_set

entries.name: supportFn_sub_le
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {K : Set E} {R : ℝ}, K.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (ξ ξ' : E), supportFn K ξ - supportFn K ξ' ≤ R * ‖ξ - ξ'‖

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesHist x hx τ p = (fun y t => (⟨x t, ⋯⟩, y.ofLp t)) ((COLT83.bayesYclm x τ) p)

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(COLT83.unitBall ι) ℝ ↑(COLT83.unitBall ι)) (T : ℕ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (A.output T)] (σ : ℝ), COLT83.bayesJointLaw A T σ = ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ).prod (COLT83.noisePairLaw A T)).withDensity fun q => ENNReal.ofReal (Learning.LinearBandit.likelihood q.1 q.2.1)

entries.name: COLT83.bayesParam_sub_smul_leastSquares
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf (x t)).PosDef → ∀ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T)), COLT83.bayesParam x τ p.1 - COLT83.bayesC τ • COLT83.leastSquares x (COLT83.bayesObs x τ p) = (COLT83.bayesW₁ x τ) p.1 + (COLT83.bayesW₂ x τ) p.2

entries.name: COLT83.blockBallSet_le_budget_of_isFixedDesign_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ) {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (1 / 10) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d) ℝ ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)), A.IsFixedBudget T → A.IsFixedDesign → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ → ↑k * ↑d ^ 2 / (210 * ε ^ 2) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: COLT83.blockBallSet_le_budget_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ), 2 ≤ k * d → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / 16) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d) ℝ ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)), A.IsFixedBudget T → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ → ↑k * ↑d * Real.log (1 / δ) / (20000 * ε ^ 2) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → {d : Fin m → ℕ} → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (v + w) = COLT83.blockCenter l v + COLT83.blockCenter l w

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp i = if i.fst = l then v.ofLp i - COLT83.blockSum v l / ↑(d l) else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply_mk_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) {j : Fin m}, j ≠ l → ∀ (k : Fin (d j)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨j, k⟩ = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_apply_mk_self
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (k : Fin (d l)), (COLT83.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ = v.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ - COLT83.blockSum v l / ↑(d l)

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l l' : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (COLT83.blockCenter l' v) = if l = l' then COLT83.blockCenter l v else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l ((COLT83.mtL d) v) = √↑(d l) • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m), COLT83.blockCenter l (COLT83.muVec d) = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (c • v) = c • COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.blockCenter_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (l : Fin m) (s : Finset α) (v : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), COLT83.blockCenter l (∑ a ∈ s, v a) = ∑ a ∈ s, COLT83.blockCenter l (v a)

entries.name: COLT83.blockEmbBall
entries.statement: {k d : ℕ} → Fin k → ↑(COLT83.unitBall (Fin d)) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)

entries.name: COLT83.blockEmb_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (p : Fin k × Fin d), ((COLT83.blockEmb i) u).ofLp p = if p.1 = i then u.ofLp p.2 else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockEmb_mem_blockBallSet
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)}, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ (i : Fin k), (COLT83.blockEmb i) u ∈ COLT83.blockBallSet k d

entries.name: COLT83.blockInd
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → (d : Fin m → ℕ) → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))

entries.name: COLT83.blockProj

entries.name: COLT83.blockProjBall
entries.statement: {k d : ℕ} → Fin k → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d) → ↑(COLT83.unitBall (Fin d))

entries.name: COLT83.blockProjBall_blockEmbBall
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : ↑(COLT83.unitBall (Fin d))), COLT83.blockProjBall i (COLT83.blockEmbBall i x) = x

entries.name: COLT83.blockProj_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k × Fin d)) (l : Fin d), ((COLT83.blockProj i) x).ofLp l = x.ofLp (i, l)

entries.name: COLT83.blockProj_blockEmb_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} {i j : Fin k}, j ≠ i → ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), (COLT83.blockProj j) ((COLT83.blockEmb i) u) = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockProj_blockEmb_same
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), (COLT83.blockProj i) ((COLT83.blockEmb i) u) = u

entries.name: COLT83.blockSeeds
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → {s K : ℕ} → 0 < s → ((_ : Fin K) × Fin s → ι → Bool) → Fin K → ι → Bool

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → {d : Fin m → ℕ} → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) → Fin m → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.blockSumLin
entries.statement: {m : ℕ} → (d : Fin m → ℕ) → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.blockSumLin_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j : Fin m) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), (COLT83.blockSumLin d j) y = COLT83.blockSum y j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (y + z) j = COLT83.blockSum y j + COLT83.blockSum z j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.blockCenter l v) j = 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum ((COLT83.mtL d) v) j = COLT83.mtA d * inner ℝ (COLT83.muVec d) v

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.muVec d) j = 1

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_oneHot
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (κ : (j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (COLT83.oneHot d κ) j = 1

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_single
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j' : Fin m) (l : Fin (d j')) (a : ℝ) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (EuclideanSpace.single ⟨j', l⟩ a) j = if j = j' then a else 0

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (c : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (c • y) j = c * COLT83.blockSum y j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (y - z) j = COLT83.blockSum y j - COLT83.blockSum z j

entries.name: COLT83.blockSum_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (s : Finset α) (y : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum (∑ a ∈ s, y a) j = ∑ a ∈ s, COLT83.blockSum (y a) j

entries.name: COLT83.card_mul_inner_radDir_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (u : ι → Bool) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ↑(Fintype.card ι) * inner ℝ (COLT83.radDir u) θ ^ 2 = (∑ i, ProbabilityTheory.signOf (u i) * θ.ofLp i) ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.card_pi_eq_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m), Fintype.card ((j : Fin m) → Fin (d j)) = d l * Fintype.card ((j : { j // j ≠ l }) → Fin (d ↑j))

entries.name: COLT83.ciSup_const_add_const_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι] (b : ℝ) {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → ∀ (f : ι → ℝ), ⨆ i, b + c * f i = b + c * ⨆ i, f i

entries.name: COLT83.coe_blockDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : ℕ → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)) (t : ℕ), ↑(COLT83.blockDesign i x t) = (COLT83.blockProj i) ↑(x t)

entries.name: COLT83.coe_blockEmbBall
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : ↑(COLT83.unitBall (Fin d))), ↑(COLT83.blockEmbBall i x) = (COLT83.blockEmb i) ↑x

entries.name: COLT83.coe_blockProjBall
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (y : ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet k d)), ↑(COLT83.blockProjBall i y) = (COLT83.blockProj i) ↑y

entries.name: COLT83.coe_normalizeBall
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ↑(COLT83.normalizeBall v) = ‖v‖⁻¹ • v

entries.name: COLT83.continuous_bayesObs
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (τ : ℝ), Continuous fun p => COLT83.bayesObs x τ p

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {u : Bool → ℝ} (s : ι → Bool), COLT83.cubeVec u s ∈ COLT83.cubeSet u

entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix ι ι ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.designMatrix_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), COLT83.designMatrix w = ∑ x ∈ w.support, w x • COLT83.outerSelf x

entries.name: COLT83.designMatrix_mapDomain
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), COLT83.designMatrix (Finsupp.mapDomain f w) = ∑ x ∈ w.support, w x • COLT83.outerSelf (f x)

entries.name: COLT83.designMatrix_mapDomain_toEuclideanCLM
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), COLT83.designMatrix (Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M)) w) = M * COLT83.designMatrix w * M.transpose

entries.name: COLT83.designMatrix_mixDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂) = (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₁ + (1 / 2) • COLT83.designMatrix w₂

entries.name: COLT83.designRows

entries.name: COLT83.designSet_image_toEuclideanCLM
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), COLT83.designSet (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M) '' 𝒳) = (fun A => M * A * M.transpose) '' COLT83.designSet 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.designWeight
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → NNReal

entries.name: COLT83.det_smul_add_smul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsUnit A.det → ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ≠ 1 → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ((1 - t) • A + t • COLT83.outerSelf x).det = (1 - t) ^ Fintype.card ι * A.det * (1 + t / (1 - t) * x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp)

entries.name: COLT83.diffSup
entries.statement: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → Set E → E → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.diffSup_eq_supportFn_add_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (v : E), COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v = supportFn (𝒳 + -𝒳) v

entries.name: COLT83.diffSup_pos_of_inner_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, IsCompact 𝒳 → Submodule.span ℝ 𝒳 = ⊤ → ∀ {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, v ≠ 0 → (∃ y ∈ 𝒳, inner ℝ y v = 0) → 0 < COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v

entries.name: COLT83.div_sqrt_three_le_gw_unitBall
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], ↑(Fintype.card ι) / √3 ≤ COLT83.gw (COLT83.unitBall ι)

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_le_gValue
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → x ∈ 𝒳 → x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ COLT83.gValue 𝒳 A

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_le_of_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → (↑T / 4) • A ≤ C → ∀ (x : ι → ℝ), x ⬝ᵥ C⁻¹.mulVec x ≤ 4 / ↑T * x ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_trace_mul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec x.ofLp = (M * COLT83.outerSelf x).trace

entries.name: COLT83.dotProduct_outerSelf_mulVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (u y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), u.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.outerSelf y).mulVec u.ofLp = inner ℝ u y ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.eigenvalues_gt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {l : ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian), (∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ B, l < x) → ∀ (i : ι), l < hB.eigenvalues i

entries.name: COLT83.eq_blockEmb_blockProj
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k × Fin d)} {i : Fin k}, (∀ (j : Fin k), j ≠ i → (COLT83.blockProj j) x = 0) → x = (COLT83.blockEmb i) ((COLT83.blockProj i) x)

entries.name: COLT83.eq_smul_muVec_add_sum_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))} {c : ℝ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), COLT83.blockSum v j = c) → v = c • COLT83.muVec d + ∑ l, COLT83.blockCenter l v

entries.name: COLT83.euclideanClm
entries.statement: {m : Type u_2} → {n : Type u_3} → [Fintype m] → [Fintype n] → [DecidableEq n] → Matrix m n ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m

entries.name: COLT83.euclideanClm_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {k : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : Fintype k] [inst_3 : DecidableEq n] [inst_4 : DecidableEq k] (M : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Matrix n k ℝ), COLT83.euclideanClm M ∘SL COLT83.euclideanClm N = COLT83.euclideanClm (M * N)

entries.name: COLT83.exists_blockProj_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k × Fin d)}, x ∈ COLT83.blockBallSet k d → ∃ i, ∀ (j : Fin k), j ≠ i → (COLT83.blockProj j) x = 0

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isAccurateNormEst
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ε δ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, ↑T ≤ 100000 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log (4 / δ) / ε ^ 2 ∧ ∃ A, A.IsFixedBudget T ∧ COLT83.IsAccurateNormEst A ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.exists_isDesign_of_mem_designSet

entries.name: COLT83.hasSubexponentialMGF_lnQ
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ProbabilityTheory.HasSubexponentialMGF (fun e => ‖COLT83.lnDelta n e‖ ^ 2 - ↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑n) ((1 / ↑n) ^ 2 * (8 * ↑(Fintype.card ι))) (|1 / ↑n| * 4) (COLT83.lnNoise ι n)

entries.name: COLT83.hasSubexponentialMGF_rbW
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < s → ∀ (u : Fin K → ι → Bool) (k : Fin K), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubexponentialMGF (fun e => COLT83.rbW s K θ (u, e) k) (8 * ((↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s) ^ 2 + (√↑(Fintype.card ι) * inner ℝ (COLT83.radDir (u k)) θ) ^ 2 * (↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s))) (4 * (↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s)) (COLT83.rbNoise s K)

entries.name: COLT83.hasSubexponentialMGF_rbX
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (k : Fin K), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubexponentialMGF (fun u => COLT83.rbX K θ u k) (16 * ‖θ‖ ^ 4) (4 * ‖θ‖ ^ 2) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.uniformBoolVec ι)

entries.name: COLT83.inner_blockCenter_left
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), inner ℝ (COLT83.blockCenter l x) y = ∑ k, x.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ * y.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ - COLT83.blockSum x l * COLT83.blockSum y l / ↑(d l)

entries.name: COLT83.inner_blockCenter_symm

entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), inner ℝ (COLT83.blockInd d j) v = COLT83.blockSum v j

entries.name: COLT83.intrinsicGw_le_gaussianWidth

entries.name: COLT83.isPAC_fixedDesignIdentAlg
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ↑𝒳} {s : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ↑𝒳} {hs : Measurable s}, IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x ↑t)).PosDef → ∀ {σ : NNReal}, 0 < σ → (∀ y ∈ 𝒳, y.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x ↑t))⁻¹.mulVec y.ofLp ≤ ↑σ ^ 2) → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → (∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), supportFn 𝒳 v - ε / 4 ≤ inner ℝ (↑(s v)) v) → 2 * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x ↑t)) + 2 * ↑σ * √(2 * ↑ProbabilityTheory.gaussianConcentrationConst * Real.log (1 / δ)) ≤ 3 * ε / 4 → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 (COLT83.fixedDesignIdentAlg T x s hs) ε δ

entries.name: COLT83.le_of_isPAC_cubeSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {u : Bool → ℝ}, 𝒳 = COLT83.cubeSet u → u false < u true → ∀ {M c : ℝ}, (∀ (b : Bool), |u b| ≤ M) → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < c → c * (u true - u false) * ↑(Fintype.card ι) = 10 * ε → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳), A.IsFixedBudget T → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ → ↑T * (c * M) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 → 1 / 6 ≤ δ

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_diffSup_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, IsCompact 𝒳 → 𝒳.Nonempty → ∀ {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {σ : NNReal}, 0 < σ → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ ↑σ ^ 2) → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 A⁻¹).real {v | 2 * COLT83.gwMat 𝒳 A + 2 * ↑σ * √(2 * ↑ProbabilityTheory.gaussianConcentrationConst * Real.log (1 / δ)) < COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v} ≤ δ

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_lt_simpleRegret_bayes_le

entries.name: COLT83.measureReal_lt_simpleRegret_comap_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑𝒳 ℝ ↑𝒳) (x : Fin T → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ∀ (t : Fin T), x t ∈ 𝒳) (τ : ℝ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (A.output T)] (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {ε : ℝ}, ((ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin T))).compProd ((COLT83.bayesKernel A x hx τ).comap (Prod.mk g) ⋯)).real {q | ε < Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g) ↑q.2} = (Learning.LinearBandit.fixedDesignPairLaw A (fun t => ⟨x t, ⋯⟩) (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g)).real {p | ε < Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (COLT83.bayesParam x τ g) ↑p.2}

entries.name: COLT83.one_sub_le_measureReal_regionCandidates
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {K T₁ : ℕ} {sel : Fin K → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ↑𝒳} {R : Fin K → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, 𝒳.Finite → 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ (i : Fin K), R i ⊆ 𝒳) → (∀ (i : Fin K), (R i).Nonempty) → 𝒳 ⊆ ⋃ i, R i → (∀ (i : Fin K) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ↑(sel i v) ∈ R i ∧ supportFn (R i) v ≤ inner ℝ (↑(sel i v)) v) → ∀ (x : Fin T₁ → ↑𝒳), (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x t)).PosDef → ∀ {σ : NNReal}, 0 < σ → (∀ y ∈ 𝒳, y.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x t))⁻¹.mulVec y.ofLp ≤ ↑σ ^ 2) → ∀ {ε' δ' : ℝ}, δ' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → (∀ (i : Fin K), 2 * COLT83.gwMat (R i) (∑ t, COLT83.outerSelf ↑(x t)) + 2 * ↑σ * √(2 * ↑ProbabilityTheory.gaussianConcentrationConst * Real.log (1 / δ')) ≤ ε') → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), 1 - δ' ≤ (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).real {η | ∃ b, supportFn 𝒳 θ - ε' ≤ inner ℝ (↑(sel b (COLT83.leastSquares (fun t => ↑(x t)) fun t => inner ℝ (↑(x t)) θ + η t))) θ}

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_abs_rbStat_sub_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → 0 < s → 0 < K → ∀ {a τ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | 2 * a < |COLT83.rbStat s K θ p - ‖θ‖ ^ 2|} ≤ (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | a < |(∑ k, COLT83.rbX K θ p.1 k) / ↑K|} + ((COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | τ < COLT83.rbVbar s K θ p.1} + 2 * Real.exp (-(↑K * min (a ^ 2 / (2 * τ)) (a / (2 * (4 * (↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s)))))))

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → 0 < s → 0 < K → ∀ {t τ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | t < |(∑ k, COLT83.rbW s K θ p k) / ↑K|} ≤ (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | τ < COLT83.rbVbar s K θ p.1} + 2 * Real.exp (-(↑K * min (t ^ 2 / (2 * τ)) (t / (2 * (4 * (↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s))))))

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_avg_rbX_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < ‖θ‖ → 0 < K → ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | t < |(∑ k, COLT83.rbX K θ p.1 k) / ↑K|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(↑K * min (t ^ 2 / (32 * ‖θ‖ ^ 4)) (t / (8 * ‖θ‖ ^ 2))))

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_fst
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} (A : Set (Fin K → ι → Bool)), (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | p.1 ∈ A} = (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.uniformBoolVec ι).real A

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_rbVbar_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < K → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι s K).real {p | 8 * ((↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s) ^ 2 + 3 * ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ‖θ‖ ^ 2 / (2 * ↑s)) < COLT83.rbVbar s K θ p.1} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(↑K / 128))

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_sqrt_addEst_gt_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → ∀ {ε δ r₀ : ℝ}, ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1 → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ε ≤ r₀ → ‖θ‖ / 2 < r₀ → r₀ ≤ 2 * ‖θ‖ → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι (COLT83.addS (Fintype.card ι) r₀) (COLT83.addK r₀ ε δ)).real {p | ε / 2 < |√(max (COLT83.rbStat (COLT83.addS (Fintype.card ι) r₀) (COLT83.addK r₀ ε δ) θ p) 0) - ‖θ‖|} ≤ 3 * δ / 8

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_test_h0_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → ∀ {t δ' : ℝ}, 0 < t → δ' ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (1 / 4) → ‖θ‖ ≤ t → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι (COLT83.testS (Fintype.card ι) t) (COLT83.testK δ')).real {p | 3 * t ^ 2 / 2 ≤ COLT83.rbStat (COLT83.testS (Fintype.card ι) t) (COLT83.testK δ') θ p} ≤ 3 * δ' / 4

entries.name: COLT83.rbMeasure_real_test_h1_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → ∀ {t δ' : ℝ}, 0 < t → δ' ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (1 / 4) → 2 * t ≤ ‖θ‖ → (COLT83.rbMeasure ι (COLT83.testS (Fintype.card ι) t) (COLT83.testK δ')).real {p | COLT83.rbStat (COLT83.testS (Fintype.card ι) t) (COLT83.testK δ') θ p < 3 * t ^ 2 / 2} ≤ 3 * δ' / 4

entries.statement: (s K : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin K → Fin s → ℝ)

entries.name: COLT83.rbNoise_real_avg_rbW_ge_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < Fintype.card ι → 0 < s → 0 < K → ∀ (u : Fin K → ι → Bool) {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → (COLT83.rbNoise s K).real {e | t ≤ |(∑ k, COLT83.rbW s K θ (u, e) k) / ↑K|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(↑K * min (t ^ 2 / (2 * COLT83.rbVbar s K θ u)) (t / (2 * (4 * (↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s))))))

entries.name: COLT83.rbStat
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (s K : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → (Fin K → ι → Bool) × (Fin K → Fin s → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.rbStat_sub_sq_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, 0 < K → ∀ (p : (Fin K → ι → Bool) × (Fin K → Fin s → ℝ)), COLT83.rbStat s K θ p - ‖θ‖ ^ 2 = (∑ k, COLT83.rbX K θ p.1 k) / ↑K + (∑ k, COLT83.rbW s K θ p k) / ↑K

entries.name: COLT83.rbVbar_pos

entries.name: COLT83.rbW
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (s K : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → (Fin K → ι → Bool) × (Fin K → Fin s → ℝ) → Fin K → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.rbW_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {s K : ℕ} {θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} (p : (Fin K → ι → Bool) × (Fin K → Fin s → ℝ)) (k : Fin K), COLT83.rbW s K θ p k = (√↑(Fintype.card ι) * COLT83.rbMean s K θ p k) ^ 2 - ((√↑(Fintype.card ι) * inner ℝ (COLT83.radDir (p.1 k)) θ) ^ 2 + ↑(Fintype.card ι) / ↑s)

entries.name: COLT83.regionalizedGw_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {κ : Type u_2} [Nonempty κ] {𝓡 : κ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {c : ℝ}, (∀ (i : κ), COLT83.gwMat (𝓡 i) A ≤ c) → COLT83.regionalizedGw A 𝓡 ≤ c

entries.statement: ∀ {k d : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (ϑ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k × Fin d)), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.blockBallSet k d) ((COLT83.blockEmb i) ϑ) y = Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.unitBall (Fin d)) ϑ ((COLT83.blockProj i) y)

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_eq_supportFn_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} (θ x : E), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x = supportFn 𝒳 θ - inner ℝ x θ

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_le_supportFn_add_supportFn
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ {θ θ' x : E}, x ∈ 𝒳 → ∀ {γ : ℝ}, supportFn 𝒳 θ' - γ ≤ inner ℝ x θ' → Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x ≤ supportFn 𝒳 (θ - θ') + supportFn 𝒳 (θ' - θ) + γ

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_smul_add_simpleRegret_neg_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {α : ℝ}, 0 ≤ α → ∀ (v y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (α • v) y + Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret 𝒳 (-(α • v)) y = α * COLT83.diffSup 𝒳 v

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_smul_signVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {u : Bool → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, u false < u true → 0 < c → ∀ (s : ι → Bool) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x ∈ COLT83.cubeSet u → Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.cubeSet u) (c • COLT83.signVec s) x = c * (u true - u false) * ↑(COLT83.hammingCard u s x)

entries.name: COLT83.simpleRegret_unitBall

entries.name: COLT83.start_regionAlg

entries.name: Finset.mem_topBy_iff_card_filter_lt

entries.name: Finset.sum_mul_sq_sub_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → R}, (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) → ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1 → ∀ {c : ι → R} {C : R}, (∀ i ∈ s, |c i| ≤ C) → ∑ i ∈ s, p i * (c i - ∑ j ∈ s, p j * c j) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2

entries.name: Finset.sum_mul_sub_mul_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {s : Finset ι} {p a b : ι → R}, ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1 → ∑ i ∈ s, p i * (a i * b i) - (∑ i ∈ s, p i * a i) * ∑ i ∈ s, p i * b i = ∑ i ∈ s, p i * ((a i - ∑ j ∈ s, p j * a j) * (b i - ∑ j ∈ s, p j * b j))

entries.name: Finset.sum_powersetCard_succ_sum_mem
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] (k : ℕ) (F : Finset ι → ι → M), ∑ S ∈ Finset.powersetCard (k + 1) Finset.univ, ∑ i ∈ S, F (S.erase i) i = ∑ B ∈ Finset.powersetCard k Finset.univ, ∑ i ∈ Bᶜ, F B i

entries.name: Finset.topKey_le_of_notMem_topBy

entries.name: Finset.topKey_le_topKey
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] {v : α → β} {a b : α}, Finset.topKey v a ≤ Finset.topKey v b ↔ v a < v b ∨ v a = v b ∧ b ≤ a

entries.name: Finset.topKey_lt_topKey
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] {v : α → β} {a b : α}, Finset.topKey v a < Finset.topKey v b ↔ v a < v b ∨ v a = v b ∧ b < a

entries.name: Fintype.card_pi_eq_mul_card_pi_subtype
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] (i : ι), Fintype.card ((j : ι) → β j) = Fintype.card (β i) * Fintype.card ((j : { j // j ≠ i }) → β ↑j)

entries.name: Fintype.sum_ite_apply_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] {R : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Semiring R] (i : ι) [inst_4 : DecidableEq (β i)] (k : β i), (∑ κ, if k = κ i then 1 else 0) = ↑(Fintype.card ((j : { j // j ≠ i }) → β ↑j))

entries.name: Fintype.sum_pi_piSplitAt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] (i : ι) (F : ((j : ι) → β j) → M), ∑ κ, F κ = ∑ a, ∑ r, F ((Equiv.piSplitAt i β).symm (a, r))

entries.name: Fintype.sum_sum_update
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] {R : Type u_3} [inst_3 : NonAssocSemiring R] (i : ι) (F : ((j : ι) → β j) → R), ∑ κ, ∑ a, F (Function.update κ i a) = ↑(Fintype.card (β i)) * ∑ κ, F κ

entries.name: InformationTheory.bernoulliBool_singleton_false

entries.name: InformationTheory.bretagnolle_huber
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {A : Set Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν], MeasurableSet A → InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν ≠ ⊤ → Real.exp (-(InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν).toReal) / 2 ≤ μ.real A + ν.real Aᶜ

entries.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerRealGap p p = 0

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal p q = p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 - p) * Real.log ((1 - p) / (1 - q))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_eq_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBerReal p q = p * (Real.log p - Real.log q) + (1 - p) * (Real.log (1 - p) - Real.log (1 - q))

entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBerReal 1 q = -Real.log q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_one_right
entries.statement: ∀ {p : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBerReal p 1 = p * Real.log p

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_one_sub
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal (1 - p) (1 - q) = InformationTheory.klBerReal p q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_pinsker
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → 0 < q → q < 1 → 2 * (p - q) ^ 2 ≤ InformationTheory.klBerReal p q

entries.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBerReal p p = 0

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_zero_left

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBerReal_zero_right
entries.statement: ∀ {p : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBerReal p 0 = (1 - p) * Real.log (1 - p)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_eq_top_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBer p q = ⊤ ↔ q = 0 ∧ p ≠ 0 ∨ q = 1 ∧ p ≠ 1

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_left
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBer 1 q = ENNReal.ofReal (-Real.log q)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_left_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klBer 1 q = if q = 0 then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (1 / q))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_right
entries.statement: ∀ {p : ℝ}, InformationTheory.klBer p 1 = if p = 1 then 0 else ⊤

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_one_sub
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBer (1 - p) (1 - q) = InformationTheory.klBer p q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_pinsker
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (p - q) ^ 2) ≤ InformationTheory.klBer p q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_self
entries.statement: ∀ (p : ℝ), InformationTheory.klBer p p = 0

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_zero_left

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_zero_left_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ}, q ≠ 0 → InformationTheory.klBer 0 q = if q = 1 then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (1 / (1 - q)))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klBer_zero_right

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_add_add_of_measure_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] {s : Set α} {μ' ν' : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ'] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν'], MeasurableSet s → μ sᶜ = 0 → ν sᶜ = 0 → μ' s = 0 → ν' s = 0 → InformationTheory.klDiv (μ + μ') (ν + ν') = InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν + InformationTheory.klDiv μ' ν'

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_bernoulliBool
entries.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → 0 < q → q < 1 → InformationTheory.klDiv (InformationTheory.bernoulliBool p) (InformationTheory.bernoulliBool q) = ENNReal.ofReal (InformationTheory.klBin p q)

entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] {x y : X}, x ≠ y → ∀ (p q : ↑unitInterval), InformationTheory.klDiv (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y p) (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y q) = InformationTheory.klBer ↑p ↑q

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_bernoulliMeasure_eq_klBerReal
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] {x y : X}, x ≠ y → ∀ (p : ↑unitInterval) {q : ↑unitInterval}, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ 1 → InformationTheory.klDiv (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y p) (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure x y q) = ENNReal.ofReal (InformationTheory.klBerReal ↑p ↑q)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_comap
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel β γ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η] {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f), InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd (κ.comap f hf)) (μ.compProd (η.comap f hf)) = InformationTheory.klDiv ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map f μ).compProd κ) ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map f μ).compProd η)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated β γ] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (π : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel π] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel β γ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η], InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α κ))) (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α η))) = ∫⁻ (b : β), InformationTheory.klDiv (κ b) (η b) ∂μ.bind ⇑π

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft_eq_klDiv_comp_compProd
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (π : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel π] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel β γ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η], InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α κ))) (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α η))) = InformationTheory.klDiv ((μ.bind ⇑π).compProd κ) ((μ.bind ⇑π).compProd η)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_eq_add_lintegral
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] (μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel η], InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd κ) (ν.compProd η) = InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν + ∫⁻ (a : α), InformationTheory.klDiv (κ a) (η a) ∂μ

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_left_of_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [Nonempty β] (μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) [ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ] {S : Set α}, MeasurableSet S → (∀ a ∈ S, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (κ a)) → (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, a ∈ S) → (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂ν, a ∈ S) → InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd κ) (ν.compProd κ) = InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_compProd_right_eq_lintegral
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η], InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd κ) (μ.compProd η) = ∫⁻ (a : α), InformationTheory.klDiv (κ a) (η a) ∂μ

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_eq_iSup_map
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] {β : ℕ → Type u_2} [mβ : (n : ℕ) → MeasurableSpace (β n)] {g : (n : ℕ) → α → β n}, (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (g n)) → (Monotone fun n => MeasurableSpace.comap (g n) (mβ n)) → ⨆ n, MeasurableSpace.comap (g n) (mβ n) = m0 → InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν = ⨆ n, InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (g n) μ) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (g n) ν)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_eq_iSup_restrict
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] {s : ℕ → Set α}, (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasurableSet (s n)) → Monotone s → ⋃ n, s n = Set.univ → InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν = ⨆ n, InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.restrict (s n)) (ν.restrict (s n))

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_finsetSum_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ ν : ι → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (ν i)] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → NNReal), InformationTheory.klDiv (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(c i) • μ i) (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(c i) • ν i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(c i) * InformationTheory.klDiv (μ i) (ν i)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_finsetSum_smul_le_of_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ν : ι → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {c : ι → NNReal} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] {s : Finset ι}, ∑ i ∈ s, c i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, c i ≠ 0) → InformationTheory.klDiv μ (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(c i) • ν i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(c i) * InformationTheory.klDiv μ (ν i)

entries.name: InformationTheory.klDiv_finsetSum_smul_right_le

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockBallSet_le_budget_of_isPAC
entries.statement: ∀ (k d : ℕ), 2 ≤ k * d → ∀ {ε δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / 16) → ∀ {T : ℕ} (A : Learning.IdentAlg ↑(Maiti2026Power.blockBallSet k d) ℝ ↑(Maiti2026Power.blockBallSet k d)), A.IsFixedBudget T → Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC (Maiti2026Power.blockBallSet k d) A ε δ → ↑k * ↑d * Real.log (1 / δ) / (20000 * ε ^ 2) ≤ ↑T

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (v + w) = Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v + Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l w

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (i : (j : Fin m) × Fin (d j)), (Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v).ofLp i = if i.fst = l then v.ofLp i - Maiti2026Power.blockSum v l / ↑(d l) else 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_apply_mk_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) {j : Fin m}, j ≠ l → ∀ (k : Fin (d j)), (Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨j, k⟩ = 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_apply_mk_self
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (k : Fin (d l)), (Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v).ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ = v.ofLp ⟨l, k⟩ - Maiti2026Power.blockSum v l / ↑(d l)

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l l' : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l' v) = if l = l' then Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v else 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l ((Maiti2026Power.mtL d) v) = √↑(d l) • Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (Maiti2026Power.muVec d) = 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (l : Fin m) (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (c • v) = c • Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockCenter_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (l : Fin m) (s : Finset α) (v : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))), Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (∑ a ∈ s, v a) = ∑ a ∈ s, Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l (v a)

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_add
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (y + z) j = Maiti2026Power.blockSum y j + Maiti2026Power.blockSum z j

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_blockCenter
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (l : Fin m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (Maiti2026Power.blockCenter l v) j = 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_mtL
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum ((Maiti2026Power.mtL d) v) j = Maiti2026Power.mtA d * inner ℝ (Maiti2026Power.muVec d) v

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_muVec
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ}, (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < d j) → ∀ (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (Maiti2026Power.muVec d) j = 1

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_single
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (j' : Fin m) (l : Fin (d j')) (a : ℝ) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (EuclideanSpace.single ⟨j', l⟩ a) j = if j = j' then a else 0

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (c : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (c • y) j = c * Maiti2026Power.blockSum y j

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} (y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (y - z) j = Maiti2026Power.blockSum y j - Maiti2026Power.blockSum z j

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.blockSum_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m → ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (s : Finset α) (y : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((j : Fin m) × Fin (d j))) (j : Fin m), Maiti2026Power.blockSum (∑ a ∈ s, y a) j = ∑ a ∈ s, Maiti2026Power.blockSum (y a) j

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.card_mul_inner_radDir_sq

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), Maiti2026Power.designMatrix (Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM M)) w) = M * Maiti2026Power.designMatrix w * M.transpose

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.designMatrix_mixDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ), Maiti2026Power.designMatrix (Maiti2026Power.mixDesign w₁ w₂) = (1 / 2) • Maiti2026Power.designMatrix w₁ + (1 / 2) • Maiti2026Power.designMatrix w₂

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.det_smul_add_smul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, IsUnit A.det → ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ≠ 1 → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ((1 - t) • A + t • Maiti2026Power.outerSelf x).det = (1 - t) ^ Fintype.card ι * A.det * (1 + t / (1 - t) * x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp)

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.diffSup_eq_supportFn_add_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {𝒳 : Set E} {R : ℝ}, 𝒳.Nonempty → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (v : E), Maiti2026Power.diffSup 𝒳 v = supportFn (𝒳 + -𝒳) v

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.diffSup_pos_of_inner_eq_zero

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.div_sqrt_three_le_gw_unitBall

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_le_of_smul_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, A.PosDef → ∀ {T : ℕ}, 0 < T → (↑T / 4) • A ≤ C → ∀ (x : ι → ℝ), x ⬝ᵥ C⁻¹.mulVec x ≤ 4 / ↑T * x ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec x

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_trace_mul_outerSelf
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec x.ofLp = (M * Maiti2026Power.outerSelf x).trace

entries.name: Maiti2026Power.euclideanClm_comp

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_compProd_prod_eq_integral_compProd_comap

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_comp_le_of_gaussianInterp_nonpos
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E'] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E'] [inst_4 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E'] [inst_5 : MeasurableSpace E'] [BorelSpace E'] {L₀ L₁ : E' →L[ℝ] E} {F : E → ℝ} {K : ℝ} {κ : Type u_3} [inst_7 : Fintype κ], ContDiff ℝ 2 F → (∀ (z : E), ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z‖ ≤ K) → ∀ (b : OrthonormalBasis κ ℝ E'), (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, ∀ (g : E'), ∑ k, ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianInterp L₀ L₁ t) g)) ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianInterp L₀ L₁ t) (b k))) ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianInterpDeriv L₀ L₁ t) (b k)) ≤ 0) → ∫ (g : E'), F (L₁ g) ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E' ≤ ∫ (g : E'), F (L₀ g) ∂ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E'

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_inner_mul_affine_mul_gaussTilt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {σ : ℝ} {b : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, S.PosSemidef → ∀ (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (r : ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ a θ * ((inner ℝ c θ + r) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ = σ ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (inner ℝ c a + (inner ℝ c θ + r) * inner ℝ (b - (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM S) θ) a) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_inner_single_sub_mul_inner_sub_mul_gaussTilt
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {σ : ℝ} {b : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, S.PosSemidef → 0 < σ → ∀ (i : ι) (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * inner ℝ c (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ = inner ℝ c ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (ProbabilityTheory.postCov σ S)) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) * ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {σ : ℝ} {b : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ}, S.PosSemidef → 0 < σ → ∀ (a c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ a (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * inner ℝ c (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ + σ ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), inner ℝ ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM S) a) (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * inner ℝ c (θ - ProbabilityTheory.postMean σ b S) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ = σ ^ 2 * inner ℝ c a * ∫ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ProbabilityTheory.gaussTilt b S θ ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussPrior σ

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.alg

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.basisRound

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.basisRound_basis
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (m : Fin d) {ℓ : ℕ}, ℓ < Q.n₂ d → Q.basisRound d (Q.T₂ d + ↑((Fintype.equivFin (Fin d)) m) * Q.n₂ d + ℓ) = some m

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.basis_round_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (m : Fin d) {ℓ : ℕ}, ℓ < Q.n₂ d → Q.T₂ d + ↑((Fintype.equivFin (Fin d)) m) * Q.n₂ d + ℓ < Q.T d

entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → ℕ → ℕ → Fin Q.k

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.blockOf_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → Q.blockOf d (↑i * Q.N d + t) = i

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.block_round_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → ↑i * Q.N d + t < Q.T₂ d

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.block_round_mod
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → (↑i * Q.N d + t) % Q.N d = t

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.estN
entries.statement: COLT83.BlockParam → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.estN_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) {y y' : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ r < Q.T₂ d, y r = y' r) → ∀ {m : ℕ}, m < Q.k → Q.estN d m y = Q.estN d m y'

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.estN_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) (i : Fin Q.k), Q.estN d (↑i) (Q.yω θ ω) = Q.P.estimate (Fin d) (Q.P.yω ((COLT83.blockProj i) θ) (COLT83.shiftSeq (↑i * Q.N d) ω))

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.estN_le_iHat
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (j : Fin Q.k), Q.estN d (↑j) y ≤ Q.estN d (↑(Q.iHat d y)) y

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.exists_argmax
entries.statement: ∀ (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (d : ℕ) (y : ℕ → ℝ), ∃ m < Q.k, ∀ j < Q.k, Q.estN d j y ≤ Q.estN d m y

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.iHat
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → Fin Q.k

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.iHat_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) {y y' : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ m < Q.k, Q.estN d m y = Q.estN d m y') → Q.iHat d y = Q.iHat d y'

entries.statement: ∀ (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < Real.log (2 / Q.δ)

entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), Measurable (Q.iHat d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.measurable_nextAction
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (t : ℕ) {n : ℕ}, Measurable fun p => Q.nextAction d t p.1 p.2

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.measurable_output
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), Measurable (Q.output d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.measurable_pastOfBlock_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ), Measurable fun h => Q.pastOfBlock d i h r

entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {n : ℕ}, Measurable fun h => Q.yOfBlock d i h

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.measurable_yω
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)), Measurable (Q.yω θ)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.nextAction
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → (↥(Finset.Iic n) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) → (Fin d → Bool) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.nextAction_block_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (i : Fin Q.k) {n : ℕ} (h : ↥(Finset.Iic n) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) (u : Fin d → Bool), Q.nextAction d (↑i * Q.N d) h u = COLT83.blockEmbBall i ((Q.P.alg (Fin d)).act0 u)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.nextAction_of_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → ∀ {n : ℕ} (h : ↥(Finset.Iic n) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) (u : Fin d → Bool), Q.nextAction d (↑i * Q.N d + t) h u = COLT83.blockEmbBall i (Q.P.nextAction t (Q.pastOfBlock d i h) (Q.P.jStar (Fin d) (Q.yOfBlock d i h)) u)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.n₂
entries.statement: COLT83.BlockParam → ℕ → ℕ

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.n₂_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < Q.n₂ d

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.one_sub_le_seedMeasure_real_output
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)), 1 - Q.δ ≤ ((Q.alg d).seedMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)).real {ω | Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) θ ↑(Q.output d ((Q.alg d).seedFinHist (fun x e => inner ℝ (↑x) θ + e) (Q.T d) ω)) ≤ Q.ε}

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.output
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → (Fin (Q.T d) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.pastOfBlock
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → Fin Q.k → {n : ℕ} → (↥(Finset.Iic n) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) → ℕ → ↑(COLT83.unitBall (Fin d))

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.recommend
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.recommend_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) {y y' : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ r < Q.T d, y r = y' r) → Q.recommend d y = Q.recommend d y'

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.recommend_yOf_seedFinHist
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ), Q.recommend d (COLT83.NormEstParam.yOf ((Q.alg d).seedFinHist (Q.F θ) (Q.T d) ω)) = Q.recommend d (Q.yω θ ω)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.regret_le
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (y : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin Q.k), |Q.estN d (↑i) y - ‖(COLT83.blockProj i) θ‖| ≤ Q.ε / 4) → ‖Q.thetaHat d y - (COLT83.blockProj (Q.iHat d y)) θ‖ ≤ Q.ε / 4 → Learning.LinearBandit.simpleRegret (COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) θ ↑(Q.recommend d y) ≤ Q.ε

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.seedAction_of_T₂_le
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) {t : ℕ}, Q.T₂ d ≤ t → (Q.alg d).seedAction (Q.F θ) t ω = match Q.basisRound d t with | some m => COLT83.blockEmbBall (Q.iHat d (Q.yω θ ω)) ⟨EuclideanSpace.single m 1, ⋯⟩ | none => Q.zeroBB d

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.seedStep_block
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → (Q.alg d).seedStep (Q.F θ) (↑i * Q.N d + t) ω = (COLT83.blockEmbBall i ((Q.P.alg (Fin d)).seedStep (COLT83.NormEstParam.F ((COLT83.blockProj i) θ)) t (COLT83.shiftSeq (↑i * Q.N d) ω)).1, ((Q.P.alg (Fin d)).seedStep (COLT83.NormEstParam.F ((COLT83.blockProj i) θ)) t (COLT83.shiftSeq (↑i * Q.N d) ω)).2)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.thetaHat
entries.statement: COLT83.BlockParam → (d : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.thetaHat_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) {y y' : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ r < Q.T d, y r = y' r) → Q.thetaHat d y = Q.thetaHat d y'

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.thetaHat_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ), Q.thetaHat d (Q.yω θ ω) = (COLT83.blockProj (Q.iHat d (Q.yω θ ω))) θ + COLT83.lnDelta (Q.n₂ d) (COLT83.lnProj (Q.T₂ d) (Q.n₂ d) ω)

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.yOfBlock
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → Fin Q.k → {n : ℕ} → (↥(Finset.Iic n) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d) × ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.yOf_seedFinHist
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) {r : ℕ}, r < Q.T d → COLT83.NormEstParam.yOf ((Q.alg d).seedFinHist (Q.F θ) (Q.T d) ω) r = Q.yω θ ω r

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.yω
entries.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d) → (ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.yω_basis
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) (m : Fin d) {ℓ : ℕ}, ℓ < Q.n₂ d → Q.yω θ ω (Q.T₂ d + ↑((Fintype.equivFin (Fin d)) m) * Q.n₂ d + ℓ) = θ.ofLp (Q.iHat d (Q.yω θ ω), m) + (ω (Q.T₂ d + ↑((Fintype.equivFin (Fin d)) m) * Q.n₂ d + ℓ)).2

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.yω_block
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (Q : COLT83.BlockParam), 0 < d → ∀ (θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin Q.k × Fin d)) (ω : ℕ → (Fin d → Bool) × ℝ) (i : Fin Q.k) {t : ℕ}, t < Q.N d → Q.yω θ ω (↑i * Q.N d + t) = Q.P.yω ((COLT83.blockProj i) θ) (COLT83.shiftSeq (↑i * Q.N d) ω) t

entries.name: COLT83.BlockParam.zeroBB
entries.statement: (Q : COLT83.BlockParam) → (d : ℕ) → ↑(COLT83.blockBallSet Q.k d)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.card_le_gValue
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], IsCompact 𝒳 → COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → IsUnit (COLT83.designMatrix w).det → ↑(Fintype.card ι) ≤ COLT83.gValue 𝒳 (COLT83.designMatrix w)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.coe_designWeight
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), ↑(COLT83.designWeight w x) = w x

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.designMatrix_mem_designSet
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → COLT83.designMatrix w ∈ COLT83.designSet 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_eq_card
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → IsUnit (COLT83.designMatrix w).det → (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.designMatrix w)⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι)) → x ∈ w.support → x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.designMatrix w)⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp = ↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.isProbabilityMeasure_mixtureHistLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} (alg : Learning.Algorithm ↑𝒳 ℝ) (N : ℕ), COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ (ε : ℝ), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (COLT83.mixtureHistLaw alg N w ε)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.mapDomain
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), COLT83.IsDesign (f '' 𝒳) (Finsupp.mapDomain f w)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.mem_of_mem_support
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → x ∈ w.support → x ∈ 𝒳

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.mixDesign
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w₁ → COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w₂ → COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂)

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.mono
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {𝒴 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → 𝒳 ⊆ 𝒴 → COLT83.IsDesign 𝒴 w

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.pos_of_mem_support
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → x ∈ w.support → 0 < w x

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.sum_designWeight
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → ∑ x ∈ w.support, COLT83.designWeight w x = 1

entries.name: COLT83.IsDesign.support_nonempty
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ}, COLT83.IsDesign 𝒳 w → w.support.Nonempty

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.designMatrix_mapDomain_normalizeMat
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ [Nonempty ι], COLT83.designMatrix (Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w)))) w) = (↑(Fintype.card ι))⁻¹ • 1

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.dotProduct_inv_designMatrix_mixDesign_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w₂ → (COLT83.designMatrix w₁).PosSemidef → ∀ {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x ∈ 𝒳 → x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.designMatrix (COLT83.mixDesign w₁ w₂))⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp ≤ 2 * ↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.dotProduct_inv_mulVec_eq_card
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → x ∈ w.support → x.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (COLT83.designMatrix w)⁻¹.mulVec x.ofLp = ↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.exists_inner_normalizeMat_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [Nonempty ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ {x₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x₁ ∈ w.support → ∃ k ∈ w.support, inner ℝ ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) x₁) ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) k) ≤ 1 / √↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.exists_separated_pair
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [Nonempty ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι → ∀ {x₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}, x₁ ∈ w.support → ∃ k ∈ w.support, inner ℝ ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) x₁) ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) k) ≤ 1 / √2 ∧ 2 - √2 ≤ ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) x₁ - (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (COLT83.normalizeMat (COLT83.designMatrix w))) k‖ ^ 2

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.exp_neg_le_of_mixture
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} (alg : Learning.Algorithm ↑𝒳 ℝ) (N : ℕ) [Nonempty ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → ∀ {R : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (ε : ℝ) {E : Set (↥(Finset.Iic N) → ↑𝒳 × ℝ)}, MeasurableSet E → ∀ {α β : ℝ}, 0 ≤ β → (COLT83.histLaw alg N 0).real E ≤ α → (∀ x ∈ w.support, (COLT83.histLaw alg N (COLT83.mixtureParam w ε x)).real Eᶜ ≤ β) → 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-((↑N + 1) * (9 * ε ^ 2 / (2 * ↑(Fintype.card ι))))) ≤ α + β

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.gValue_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒳 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →₀ ℝ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι], COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign 𝒳 w → IsCompact 𝒳 → COLT83.gValue 𝒳 (COLT83.designMatrix w) = ↑(Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: COLT83.IsGOptimalDesign.gwMat_le_card

entries.name: Matrix.IsHermitian.inv_sub_smul_one_eq_cfc

entries.name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posDef_sub_smul_one_iff
